name: Sonar API
description:
App Store Optimization data for AI agents, MCP tools, and automation. Keyword research, rank tracking, ASO scoring, reviews, and revenue estimates for the iOS App Store and Google Play.

Versioning & deprecation policy: the API is URL-versioned (`/api/v1`). Breaking changes only ever ship under a new version path — existing `/api/v1` shapes are additive-only. If an endpoint is ever deprecated it keeps working for at least 6 months, signals the timeline with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers, and is announced at https://trysonar.app/changelog.
